encode_string_to_bytes: encode a string to UTF-8 bytes using the grpc _common encode function
decode_bytes_to_string: decode UTF-8 bytes to a string using the grpc _common decode function
serialize_message: serialize a message using a custom serializer via the grpc _common serialize function
deserialize_message: deserialize a serialized message using a custom deserializer via the grpc _common deserialize function
build_fully_qualified_method: build a fully qualified gRPC method path from a group and method name
